Cloud Library Test 2: English and filenames

作者：云端书架测试

Chapter 1 — A small library

This is an original test book for a Kindle cloud library. A small file can still test a complete journey: create, upload, browse, download, and read.

The file name contains a space, a plus sign, and Chinese characters. The object key must survive URL encoding without changing its meaning.
